serverInfo.name: GPTHuman MCP Server
serverInfo.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes GPTHuman's AI humanization API. It provides tools for transforming AI-generated text into more natural, human-sounding writing that successfully bypasses AI detectors, while preserving the requested tone and rewrite mode.
